title: Phantom Smoothing Blur Lip Balm
descriptionHtml:
✓ Matte Finish✓ Long-wearing✓ Hyaluronic Acid✓ Vegan✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Hydrating
What it is: A lip-perfecting balm that delivers feather-light, blurred color—designed to enhance tone, leaving lips smooth and nourished for up to 12 hours.

Formulation Type: Lip Balm & Treatment

Benefits: Hydrating, Long-wearing, Plumping

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Conditioning Complex: A blend of emollients and oils that nourishes, smooths, and softens.
- Smoothing Gel-Base and Hyaluronic Acid: Blurs the appearance of lips.
- Emollient and Oil Blend: Nourishes the skin barrier for up to 12 hours.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, phthalates, mineral oil, and triclosan. It is also vegan and cruelty-free.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
Artistry Tips:
Soft Focus Blurred Lip:
-Step one: Apply Phantom Blur Balm generously across your lips for a smooth, soft-focus base.
-Step two: Define and refine with Shape & Sculpt Lip Liner (sold separately). Start at the bottom corners using the flat side for a gentle outline, then switch to the tip at the Cupid’s bow and glide outward. Gently blur out the liner. This technique creates a polished yet diffused finish—think cashmere-soft lips with a blurred, effortless elegance.

Defined Blurred Lip:
-Step one: Define your lip shape with Shape & Sculpt Lip Liner. Begin at the bottom corners using the flat side for a soft outline, then transition to the tip at the Cupid’s bow and glide outward toward the corners for a refined contour.
-Step two: Gently smudge and blend the liner to diffuse the color, creating a soft-focus, yet defined effect.
-Step three: Finish with your matching Phantom Blur Balm for a dimensional, blurred lip look that feels effortlessly chic.
-Step four: Layer and top with pearlescent glossy balm for added shine and volume.
Ingredients+
-Conditioning Complex: A blend of emollients and oils that nourishes, smooths, and softens.
-Smoothing Gel-Base and Hyaluronic Acid: Blurs the appearance of lips.
-Emollient and Oil Blend: Nourishes the skin barrier for up to 12 hours.

Dimethicone, Phenyl Trimethicone, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Synthetic Wax, Tribehenin, Polyglyceryl-2 Triisostearate, Diisostearyl Malate, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Polysilicone-11, Fragrance/Parfum, Caprylyl Glycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Propanediol, Aluminum Hydroxide, Vanillin, Illicium Verum (Anise) Fruit Extract, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Mangifera Indica (Mango) Seed Butter, Butylene Glycol, Water/Aqua/Eau, Sodium Hyaluronate, Red 7 Lake (Ci 15850), Yellow 6 Lake (Ci 15985), Iron Oxide (Ci 77499), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891).

*Ingredient lists and claims may change or vary from time to time as part of Hourglass’s commitment to innovation and maintaining global compliance. Please refer to the ingredient list on the product packaging you receive to ensure the ingredients are suitable for your personal use.
